query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `historical_cigarettes` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `brand_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `manufacturer` varchar(255),
  `country_of_origin` varchar(100),
  `years_active` varchar(50),
  `year_introduced` int,
  `year_discontinued` int,
  `tobacco_blend` text,
  `tobacco_types` text,
  `additives` text,
  `flavor_profile` text,
  `nicotine_content` decimal(5,2),
  `tar_content` decimal(5,2),
  `filter_type` varchar(100),
  `packaging_description` text,
  `marketing_claims` text,
  `historical_significance` text,
  `discontinuation_reason` text,
  `collector_value` varchar(100),
  `related_brands` text,
  `source_references` text,
  `image_url` text,
  `created_at` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT `historical_cigarettes_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);
